section5.test: E2 end to end: an approved Laya enablement installs only after its claim, and a synthetic rule matches through E into its target
E2 end to end: a Laya value in the uncertain band is held, survives a restart, and the kind disable purges it and keeps the verified trees
E2 end to end: disable-all kills the in-flight Laya worker, settles its reservation and keeps the verified trees
E2 end to end: a failed boundary proof leaves Laya failed across a restart until its person disables and re-enables it
E2: the daemon tarball carries Laya’s reviewed assets, the placeholder lock and its worker, and no runtime or model
E2: the built daemon reads its shipped Laya assets and keeps Laya held, through its own CLI and owner
E2 release end to end: the local release refuses a copied state shipping a real lock without gate evidence, before its verify and any publish
E2 release gate: the owner's manual macOS checklist is supplemental: no release check reads it, and in the evidence's place it is refused

traceability.test: E2 end to end held path: with the shipped placeholder lock a Laya rule is configuration, every way to run it refuses, and a restart changes nothing
E2 Laya judge test: where Laya is not offered, a Laya judge test names Laya’s own reason before any rule authority
E2 end to end: a crashed worker is no-match with its estimate charged, and the next call starts a freshly proved child
E2 end to end: a stop during the download resumes the install at the next start, and a disable during it deletes the partial
E2 end to end: the owner’s stop kills its idle Laya worker and leaves no worker directory behind
E2: the daemon tarball carries Laya’s reviewed assets, the placeholder lock and its worker, and no runtime or model
E2 release end to end: the release job's gate refuses a copied state shipping a real lock without gate evidence, before any registry request
